title: feature subset weighting for distance-based supervised learning through choquet integration
core_idea: Use monotone measures and the Choquet integral to define distance metrics for distance-based supervised learning that weight feature subsets, capture non-linear relationships and interactions among attributes, remain robust to duplicate and strongly correlated features, and reduce computational complexity by requiring only m subset weights instead of 2^m.
tldr: Introduce a Choquet-integral-based feature-subset weighting framework to create flexible, interaction-aware distance/similarity measures for distance-based supervised learning (e.g., kNN), with computationally feasible weighting and exploration of similarity-distance duality and symmetric Choquet distances.
